content_fields.title: Implement secure build worker management (GitHub)
content_fields.guidance: Build workers should be ephemeral, isolated per job, run with least privilege, have no standing access to production credentials, and be rebuilt from a known-good image rather than reused across jobs.
content_fields.found: No build automation is configured; images are built locally through Docker Compose.
content_fields.missing: A build worker fleet and its provisioning configuration.
content_fields.conclusion: Build worker management is an infrastructure concern owned by the CI/CD platform, with nothing in this repository to change.
content_fields.action: The CI/CD platform team should define and own the build worker baseline.
